incidents.name: Truebit TRU bonding-curve pool overflow
incidents.notes: The pre-0.8 bonding-curve pool's getPurchasePrice() overflowed an unchecked intermediate addition, returning 0 wei as the cost of minting ~240M TRU, which the attacker sold back into the pool's ETH reserve (8,535 ETH).

sources.ref: onchain review: victim is an AdminUpgradeabilityProxy created 2021-04-11 by 0x749b6d893b99b161bccd32b224940cde2ecd4c94 (not the attacker); EIP-1967 impl slot holds 0xc186e6f0163e21be057e95aa135edd52508d14d3 and the proxy emitted no Upgraded event between creation and the incident, so the exploited code is the 2021 deployment. CertiK reports $26.6M / 8,535.36 ETH.

deployment-basis recheck (storage, not events): callTracer shows the exploit's three DELEGATECALLs from the proxy all go to 0xc186e6f0163e21be057e95aa135edd52508d14d3. eth_getStorageAt on the EIP-1967 implementation slot 0x360894a1...2bbc returns that same address at the creation block 12218203, at the incident block 24191019 and at all 201 evenly spaced samples in between; the proxy runtime is byte-identical at both blocks and it emitted no Upgraded event. The 2021 implementation is what executed; deployment is the correct basis, 1733.2 days.
